observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage with a white backdrop and projected graphics, decorated with tinsel
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women, appearing to be teenagers or young adults; performing in couples and as a group
observation.formation_and_space: group begins spread across the stage, alternating between kneeling in formations and dancing in pairs or small groups moving across the stage
observation.posture: upright torso, slight forward lean during energetic footwork, knees bent with weight shifting dynamically
observation.footwork: fast rhythmic stepping, stomping, heel clicks, and kicks on the beat; camera angle and distance obscure exact weight transfers
observation.arms_and_hands: arms move actively overhead and to the sides; holding yellow cloths (pañuelos) or hats
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal hip isolation; torso upright with occasional body turns and leaning
observation.partnering: couples dance in close proximity facing each other, circling and interacting without continuous body contact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent jumps, leaps, single turns, and kneeling or squatting on the floor
observation.costume_and_props: women wear wide-brimmed hats, dark tops, yellow shawls, and colorful multi-layered patterned skirts; men wear hats, white shirts, embroidered vests, dark trousers, and patterned sashes; holding yellow cloths and black hats
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details and precise weight distribution are obscured by low video resolution and distance

signature_moments.what: dancers leap and kick energetically while waving yellow cloths overhead in unison
dancers drop quickly to one knee while spinning and holding cloths out
women spin rapidly in place, causing their multi-layered skirts to flare outwards
couples face each other, stepping lively while swinging hats and cloths
